integrity: Exact case reduction and standalone certificate included; all six-factor witness divisor pairs are explicitly given; no empirical inference from an unbounded search.
scientific_limitations: Only odd squarefree positive integers are treated; the minimum is in distinct prime-support cardinality, not integer size. The negative step is a mathematically bounded exhaustive 87-case integer certificate; no higher-support classification or infinitude result is claimed. Other independent validation remains outstanding.
title: Sharp six-prime support for odd squarefree strongly pseudoperfect numbers
